title: RationalTime
description: Canonical JSON serialization of choirloom::score::RationalTime - exact rational musical time for ScoreIR. Whole note == 1 (a quarter note is 1/4). DRAFT / NON-FROZEN. Two-level validation: this schema enforces the canonical decimal-string syntax only; the exact signed int64 range and the reduced-canonical invariants (fully reduced, gcd(numerator, denominator) == 1, denominator > 0, zero == 0/1) are enforced semantically by the core (RationalTime::from_canonical_json). See docs/rational-time-notes.md.

numerator.description: Reduced numerator as a decimal string; the sign is carried here. Canonical zero is 0. No '+', no leading zeros, '-0' is not canonical. Signed int64 range is enforced by the core, not by this pattern.

denominator.description: Reduced positive denominator as a decimal string. No leading zeros; 0 is never canonical. Positive int64 range is enforced by the core, not by this pattern.
